projectDescription: A runtime bridge that lets JavaScript import and call Python modules directly — no REST APIs, servers, or glue code required.
keyFeatures: Import Python modules in JavaScript using python() helper or python: import syntax
Call Python functions, instantiate classes, and read module constants from JS
Bidirectional type serialization (None/null, bool, int, float, str, list, dict, class instances)
Python errors cross the bridge with full traceback and error type information
Single persistent Python worker process — spawned once, reused across all calls
JSON-RPC over stdin/stdout — no network, no ports, no servers
CLI (esem run) for running JS files with python: import syntax enabled
ESEM_PYTHON env var for custom Python interpreter (virtualenvs, etc.)
Automatic worker shutdown when Node.js exits
publicApiSurface: PythonError (class, extends Error) — err.message, err.pythonTraceback, err.name
